marshFever.label: Marsh fever
marshFever.description: Fatal if it outpaces immunity. Bed rest and tending slow it down.

winterCough.label: Winter cough
winterCough.description: Catching: it spreads to anyone close by. Hardest on the old and the very young. Bed rest and tending see most through it.

greyFlu.label: Grey flu
greyFlu.description: A winter flu, catching and stronger than a cough: untended, it can kill, the old above all. Bed rest and a doctor see most through it.

shakingSickness.label: Shaking sickness
shakingSickness.description: Comes with travellers and passes by touch: anyone right beside the sick can catch it. Deadly without a doctor.
